name: Ombre Body Mist- Blue Pearl (W) -120ml
description:
"Enjoy the whispers of oceanic breezes, the timeless elegance. A Floral Aquatic fragrance that gives a vibe of fresh cool water with the embrace of White Daisies. Spray the mist directly on your skin focusing on the nerve points like wrists and neck.

Top Note: Fresh Breezy and Sparkling Water
Middle Note: White Daisy
Last Note: Vanilla and Sandalwood

All-day protection against sweat odor
Long-lasting fragrance
Quick absorption, non-greasy
Unisex fragrance
Inspired by One Summer from CK
 
Caution:
Do not expose to temperature exceeding 50°C. Avoid direct contact with eyes and broken skin. In case of any irritation, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children."
